prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Chicago for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” orthodontist in Chicago—your best fit depends on your neighborhood, budget, whether you’re an adult or child, and whether your case is straightforward Invisalign or more complex braces/jaw-bite correction.

For a high-quality choice, prioritize an **orthodontist** (not just a general dentist offering Invisalign) who is:

- **Board certified by the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO)** or has extensive orthodontic-only experience  
- Willing to show you similar before/after cases  
- Clear about total cost, refinements, retainers, and what happens if treatment takes longer  
- Offering both braces and Invisalign rather than steering every patient toward one option  
- Convenient enough for regular adjustment visits

Chicago-area practices frequently considered worth consulting include:

- **Van Vliet Orthodontics** — Chicago; known for braces and Invisalign treatment  
- **McSurdy Orthodontics** — Chicago area; orthodontic-focused care  
- **Windy City Orthodontics** — multiple Chicago-area locations  
- **Orthodontic Experts** — multiple locations; can be convenient and often has flexible financing  

I’d book **2–3 complimentary consultations** rather than choose solely from online ratings. Ask each office:

1. “Am I equally good candidate for braces and Invisalign?”  
2. “How long will treatment realistically take?”  
3. “What is the all-in price—including retainers and Invisalign refinements?”  
4. “Will the orthodontist personally see me at most visits?”  
5. “Can I see before-and-after cases similar to mine?”  

For many adults with mild-to-moderate crowding, Invisalign can work very well. For significant bite problems, rotated teeth, impacted teeth, or cases requiring precise tooth movement, **traditional braces or clear braces may be more predictable**.

If you share your Chicago neighborhood, age, and whether you prefer Invisalign or braces, I can narrow this to the most practical offices to consult.
